## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, The Driver's License

FACT_ID: sec01-R01 | anchor: A01
Class D, E, and M letters mark non-commercial driving while A, B, and C mark commercial weight and passenger tiers [A01].
Why it matters: group drivers-license; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F01, sec01-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec01-R02 | anchor: A02
Moped riders earn Class E through knowledge and vision tests alone, while every other first-timer also faces a skills test [A02].
Why it matters: group drivers-license; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F04, sec01-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec01-R03 | anchor: A06
The permit-side 180 days unlock the road test, while the intermediate-side 180 days unlock the full license [A06].
Why it matters: group drivers-license; difficulty medium; prereq sec01-F12; confusables sec01-F14, sec01-F15 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0014]

FACT_ID: sec01-R04 | anchor: A11
The written test passes at 80 percent on rules questions, while the road test is judged live by a riding examiner [A11].
Why it matters: group drivers-license; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F22, sec01-F23 [A11].
Source: [A11 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec01-R05 | anchor: A13
A single crash, violation, or dangerous act fails the road test at once, while ignored examiner instructions take two strikes to disqualify [A13].
Why it matters: group drivers-license; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F25 [A13].
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec01-R06 | anchor: Y06
New residents must license within 30 days, while college students may keep a valid home license beside a school ID [Y06] [Y06S0].
Why it matters: group drivers-license; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F27, sec01-F28 [Y06].
Source: [Y06 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec01-R07 | anchor: A15
Civilians with international permits test along a reciprocity ladder, while stationed troops renew test-free inside 90 days of return [A15].
Why it matters: group drivers-license; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F29, sec01-F30 [A15].
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec01-R08 | anchor: A16
Birthdays allow 31 days to renew an adult license, while address or name changes allow only 10 days for a duplicate [A16].
Why it matters: group drivers-license; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F31, sec01-F32 [A16].
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec01-R09 | anchor: A17
Single grave acts suspend driving at once, while lesser offenses suspend only at 12 points or 7 below 18 [A17].
Why it matters: group drivers-license; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec01-F33, sec01-F34 [A17].
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec01-R10 | anchor: A18
Traffic school follows a court referral for minor violations, while a DUI program follows every conviction before any reinstatement [A18].
Why it matters: group drivers-license; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec01-F35, sec01-F36 [A18].
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-ky-d:kentucky-state-police-ksp-driver-testing:handbook:pdf-0026]
